title: Uniform pushforward density
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $g$ map $\Omega$ to the binary cube of dimension $n$. The uniform pushforward density assigns to each cube point $x$ the value $2^n\,|g^{-1}(x)|/|\Omega|$, where $g^{-1}(x)=\{\omega\in\Omega:g(\omega)=x\}$.
hypotheses_covered: A map from $\Omega$ to the binary cube of dimension $n$
